text:
Elena (PM): Quick update — SparkStream is GA for hosted today :tada: Streaming + Tool-Calling v2 is available under the new /v3/stream endpoint. Mosaic-spark and elara-lite are the initial GA models. Docs + migration guide: https://redwood.ai/docs/sparkstream

Jae (Eng): Nice! Any breaking changes clients should know about?

Elena (PM): Yes — please upgrade SDK to >= 1.12.0. Streaming wire protocol is backward-incompatible with v2 SSE. We provide a compatibility shim for a short window but plan to deprecate /v2/sse (see timeline below).

Priya (EngOps): Rollout plan: canary keys in us-west are live now (completed 1999000030). Gradual region rollout over 72h. Customers with reserved Dedicated capacity will get a scheduled maintenance email if they opt into autoswitching.

deploy-bot: deploy started for hosted/sparkstream v1.0.0 — canary -> 12% -> 50% progression (CI: all green)

Ravi (SRE): Ops notes: default autoscale backpressure now respects token-emit targets; fallback policy = route->mosaic-lite when quota/latency breaches. Observability: span.tags include spark.stream_variant and toolcall_v2=true. If you see elevated 5xx after migration, set SPARKSTREAM_FALLBACK=true.

Jae (Eng): Any changes to tool-calling contract?

Elena (PM): Tool-calling v2 adds structured JSON outputs and deterministic call ordering. Example request snippet (python):

```python
from redwood import StreamingClient
client = StreamingClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'])
with client.stream(endpoint='/v3/stream', model='mosaic-spark') as s:
    s.send({"input": "summarize: repo PR#123"})
    for msg in s:
        print(msg)
```

Responses may include tool call frames: {"tool_call": {"name": "search", "args": {...}}} — SDK will surface these as ToolCall objects.

Sofia (Docs): I'll push a migration doc + quickstart update in the docs site and the SDK repo within the hour. Migration checklist will include: SDK upgrade, switch endpoint to /v3/stream, enable_kv_cache recommended, verify kv_cache retention policy. Link: https://redwood.ai/docs/sparkstream/migrate

Priya (EngOps): Deprecation timeline: /v2/sse deprecated today for new sessions; full shutdown of v2 streaming planned 2026-08-15. We'll send customer notices and provide an automated opt-in migration tool in Console.

Jae (Eng): What about latency/cost?

Elena (PM): Typical p50 latency improved ~30% for short-turn workloads; cost per token roughly equivalent to quantized mosaic-lite at same latency SLOs. Recommendation: enable batching window = 20ms for high-throughput, kv_cache for repeated prefixes.

Ravi (SRE): Fallback plan: if canary shows regressions, will roll canary back to v2 in 15m windows and open a rollback ticket. Alerting: slack #incidents will receive high-priority alerts if error-rate > 3% for 5m.

Elena (PM): Action items: @eng please coordinate SDK release, @docs push migration guide, @engops monitor canary dashboards. Support contact: support@redwood.ai and internal runbook: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/sparkstream

Sofia (Docs): Updated quickstart live: https://redwood.ai/docs/quickstarts/sparkstream (will add sample tool-calling walkthrough)

Jae (Eng): Thanks — we'll prioritize the SDK patch and test harness.

Elena (PM): Thanks everyone — flag issues here or ping me DMs for customer-specific exceptions. :rocket:
